Medium close-up at eye level, 50mm lens, composed in 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) stands beside a low concrete parapet on an open downtown rooftop, holding the opened lipstick from (CORAL_LIPSTICK) beside her face and a smartphone just below it, poised to use its dark reflection as a mirror. Scarlett (Image 1)’s weight shifts toward the phone, eyes fixed on the reflection, with space around the hands for the imminent touch-up. Potted ornamental grasses move in the foreground, pale sky and reflective glass towers behind. Warm late-afternoon sunlight rims the rooftop and Scarlett (Image 1), with airy directional shadows. Fresh editorial social-first beauty photography, clean true-to-life color, vivid coral accent, tactile realism.
